_what: The utterances the soak load generator plays into the room (#389, SDS §12.6).
_why: An unattended robot does nothing — S10.4's presence rule refuses to speak to an empty room — so a 72-hour window over an idle process measures nothing. These are what give it work: real speech, through the real microphone, opening real Realtime sessions.
_format: 16 kHz mono 16-bit WAV. The rate matches the microphone; playback resamples anyway, so this is for tidiness rather than necessity.
_recording: ⚠️ Do NOT pad the files with trailing silence. The generator inserts the gap itself, because [gate] silence_hold_ms must elapse AFTER the speech for the falling edge to fire — silence baked into the clip is silence the robot spends the session waiting through.
_validate: uv run --frozen python docs/demos/soak_load.py --mode validate --corpus assets/load --config config/sim.toml

utterances.text: remember that I take my coffee black.
what do you know about how I take my coffee?
what's the weather like out there?
remind me to stretch at four o'clock.
how long have you been running?
what do you remember about me?
what kind of music should I put on?
alright, talk to you in a bit.
